items.computation: The letter is dated 29.09.2025 (Monday) and the period runs from the date of the letter itself, not from delivery. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (29.09.2025) is not counted; counting starts 30.09.2025. The letter defines Werktage as Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting 12 such working days forward from 30.09.2025 (Sep 30, Oct 1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11,13,14 — skipping Sunday Oct 5 and Oct 12, and no NW public holiday falls in this window) lands on Tuesday 14.10.2025.
